question: _______ became the first bank to get Reserve Bank of India's approval for rupee trade.
solution:
The correct answer is __**UCO Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• UCO Bank has received the RBI’s approval to open a special vostro account with Gazprombank of Russia for trade settlement in Indian rupees.
 
• With this, it has become the first bank to receive RBI’s approval to settle trade in Indian currency.
 
• On 11 July 2022, RBI issued a circular allowing trade settlements between India and other countries in rupee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UCO Bank is one of the nationalized banks in India.
 
• It is under the ownership of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
 
• Based on 2020 data, it is ranked 80 on the Fortune India 500 list.
 
• UCO Bank:
 
 
• Headquarters: Kolkata
 
• CEO: Soma Sankara Prasad (1 Jan 2022–)
 
• Founded: 6 January 1943
 
• Founder: Ghanshyam Das Birla
